name: Heart pony
tips: `make` builds the targets listed in a Makefile. `make love` fails: no target is called love.
A Makefile target says what to build, from which files, and how. `make` only rebuilds what changed.
When a command fails, read its error message to the end: it usually says exactly what is missing.
personal: Aww, you tried to make love. Here's a hug instead.
Be kind to your terminal, it works hard.
